# Write-free e2e: missing/malformed-input error-ID scenarios not covered by
# catalog.txt / validate_invalid.txt / flags.txt (bead go-foundry-cli-wet.2.3).

# --- missing required --spec ---
! exec foundry plan
stderr 'required flag'

! exec foundry validate
stderr 'required flag'

# --- invalid --verify ---
! exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --verify bogus
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid

! exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --verify bogus --output json
stdout 'usage.invalid'
assert_error_id stdout usage.invalid

# --- invalid --output / --color (plan, not just version) ---
! exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --output xml
stderr 'usage.invalid'

! exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --color pink
stderr 'usage.invalid'

# --- nonexistent spec path ---
! exec foundry validate --spec does-not-exist.toml
stderr 'usage.invalid'
stderr 'specification file not found'
assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid

! exec foundry plan --spec does-not-exist.toml --output json
stdout 'usage.invalid'
stdout 'specification file not found'
assert_error_id stdout usage.invalid

# --- empty stdin ---
stdin empty.toml
! exec foundry validate --spec -
stderr 'spec\.'

# --- oversized stdin (> 1 MiB cap, REQ-038) ---
write_size oversized.toml 1048577
stdin oversized.toml
! exec foundry validate --spec -
stderr 'spec.too_large'
assert_error_id stderr spec.too_large

write_size oversized.toml 1048577
stdin oversized.toml
! exec foundry validate --spec - --output json
stdout 'spec.too_large'
assert_error_id stdout spec.too_large

# --- permission denied (unreadable spec path) ---
# Meaningless as root: permission bits are bypassed (bd condition "root");
# kept last so `skip` only drops this trailing block, not earlier assertions.
[root] skip 'permission-denied scenario has no effect when running as root'
[unix] chmod 000 unreadable.toml
[unix] ! exec foundry validate --spec unreadable.toml
[unix] stderr 'usage.invalid'
[unix] stderr 'cannot read specification'
[unix] assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid
[unix] chmod 644 unreadable.toml

-- unreadable.toml --
schema = 1
name = "unreadable"
module = "github.com/example/unreadable"
description = "spec content is irrelevant; permission-denied before decode"
archetype = "cli"
destination = "./unreadable"
profiles = []

-- empty.toml --
